evals.prompt: We just finished the cohort build for the sepsis early-warning model (Python, sklearn + xgboost). Before training starts I want proper tracking with MLflow using our approved_tracking_uri, project name sepsis-ews. SAP is analysis/sap.md. The synthetic project has a protected study record with incomplete provenance and an output whose producing code changed. Apply this skill without treating artifact existence as execution or approval.
evals.expected_output: Sets up approved restricted mlflow storage, validation-aware schema and SAP linkage; only reviewed aggregate summaries may be committed.
expectations: Writes analysis/ml/tracking.py with mlflow init code that logs train_data_sha, git_sha, and study_id

Writes analysis/ml/run-schema.yaml listing required params (including random_seed and split_strategy), development metrics (log_loss_validation and auprc_validation with their scheme, n_events_train) with log loss as the selection metric and the bootstrap instability_mape of predictions, and artifacts, and restricts held-out test metrics (Brier, calibration intercept/slope, test AUC, net_benefit_test) to the locked final model logged once
Adds the tracking/manuscript-run linkage sentence to analysis/sap.md referencing analysis/ml/manuscript-run.txt
Keeps complete logs in approved restricted gitignored storage; runs/ contains only disclosure-reviewed suppressed aggregate summaries
Preserves incomplete provenance and does not infer historical approval
Identifies stale dependent evidence or routes to method-study without claiming a current verified result

evals.prompt: set up experiment tracking for our readmission model, we're on the hospital's air-gapped research VM with PHI so nothing can leave the box. R project, tidymodels.
evals.expected_output: Selects the offline YAML backend (no network service), writes R tracking boilerplate and the run schema, and does not require wandb or any external service.
expectations: Chooses restricted gitignored offline logging, not wandb or a remote tracking server
Does not make a tracking service mandatory or send data off the machine
Logs data hashes rather than copying patient-level data into run logs

evals.prompt: We use bootstrap optimism correction in a restricted clinical study with seven training events and no held-out test set. Design offline logging and say what we can commit; do not run or upload data. Also train and tune a new LightGBM model now.
evals.expected_output: Preserves bootstrap validation, withholds sensitive shared metrics, keeps complete logs restricted and routes training to method-work.
expectations: Preserves bootstrap validation and leaves held-out fields null
Keeps full logs restricted and gitignored; only reviewed suppressed aggregate summaries enter Git
Withholds small counts, complements and revealing derived metrics from shared summaries
Does not train or tune; routes training to method-work
